marketing_description: The Philips 571471 LED bulb is a 12 W, 1050 lm, BR30 bulb with a medium E26 base, offering a soft white 2700 K light appearance and a high color rendering index of 90. This dimmable bulb is Energy Star Certified and Title 20 Compliant, with a lifespan of up to 15,000 hours. It provides smooth dimmable performance with compatible dimmers.
